name: Adam Firdaus
shortBio: Trusted property consultant specialising in residential and investment properties across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.
longBio: With over a decade of experience in the Malaysian property market, I help buyers, sellers and investors find the right property with clarity and confidence. From first-time homes in Subang Jaya to premium condominiums in Mont Kiara, I provide honest guidance, thorough market insight and a personal service from viewing to key handover.
